name: Russo-Ukrainian War
summary: Full-scale war following Russia's 2022 invasion of Ukraine, preceded by the 2014 annexation of Crimea and the conflict in the Donbas. Frontlines run through eastern and southern Ukraine.

name: Israel–Hamas War (Gaza)
summary: Conflict between Israel and Hamas-led Palestinian militant groups centered on the Gaza Strip, following the October 7, 2023 attack, with major humanitarian and regional spillover effects including the West Bank and border clashes with Hezbollah in Lebanon.

name: Sudanese Civil War
summary: Power struggle between the Sudanese Armed Forces (SAF) and the paramilitary Rapid Support Forces (RSF), producing one of the world's largest displacement and hunger crises.

name: Myanmar Civil War
summary: Nationwide armed conflict between the military junta (which seized power in a 2021 coup), the shadow National Unity Government, and a patchwork of ethnic armed organizations.

name: Syria: Post-Assad Transition Conflict
summary: Following the fall of the Assad government in late 2024, Syria remains fractured, with an interim government, sectarian violence, Kurdish-led autonomous forces in the northeast, and continued foreign military involvement.

name: Yemen Conflict & Red Sea Crisis
summary: Yemen's civil war between the Houthi movement and the internationally recognized government, which has spilled into Red Sea shipping lanes via Houthi attacks on commercial vessels.

name: Sahel Jihadist Insurgency
summary: Islamist insurgency across Mali, Burkina Faso, and Niger involving groups linked to al-Qaeda and the Islamic State, amid a wave of military coups and the withdrawal of Western forces.

name: Korean Armistice / DMZ Standoff
summary: The Korean War ended in an armistice, not a peace treaty; North and South Korea remain technically at war, separated by the heavily fortified Demilitarized Zone.

name: South China Sea Disputes
summary: Overlapping sovereignty claims among China, Taiwan, Vietnam, the Philippines, Malaysia, and Brunei over reefs, islands, and shipping lanes, punctuated by naval standoffs and China's construction of militarized artificial islands.

name: Taiwan Strait
summary: China claims Taiwan as part of its territory under a 'One China' policy; Taiwan operates as a self-governing democracy. Chinese military exercises and incursions into Taiwan's air defense zone are recurring flashpoints.

name: Kashmir
summary: India and Pakistan both claim the Kashmir region in full and administer separate portions, divided by the Line of Control; China also administers a portion (Aksai Chin). The dispute has triggered multiple wars and periodic cross-border strikes.

name: Crimea
summary: Annexed by Russia in 2014 following a disputed referendum; recognized internationally as sovereign Ukrainian territory under military occupation.

name: Golan Heights
summary: Captured by Israel from Syria in the 1967 war and effectively annexed in 1981; the annexation is recognized by the United States but not by the United Nations.

name: West Bank
summary: Under Israeli military occupation since 1967, with Palestinian Authority civil administration in parts of the territory and ongoing Israeli settlement expansion considered illegal under international law by most of the international community.

name: Western Sahara
summary: Morocco controls most of the territory and considers it part of Morocco; the Polisario Front, backed by Algeria, seeks independence for the Sahrawi Arab Democratic Republic. A UN-monitored ceasefire has been fraying since 2020.

name: Nagorno-Karabakh
summary: Azerbaijan retook full control of the region in a September 2023 offensive, ending three decades of separatist Armenian rule and triggering the exodus of nearly the entire ethnic Armenian population; final political status remains contentious.

name: Transnistria
summary: A breakaway strip of Moldova along the Ukrainian border, run by an unrecognized pro-Russian government and hosting a residual Russian military presence since a 1992 ceasefire.
